name: Mobile County, AL
findings: Mobile County has 1,170 nonprofit organizations. 388 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 303 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mobile County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 28 would.
